name: Slippery Kiss
source:
After receiving some unusual slime samples, Noah's academic studies spiral off into the world slime creatures.

Against all expectations, Noah's slime samples show some very unique abilities. They transform from cute blobs into full-figured slime women with lots of even cuter bits and blobs. Now, Noah has a lot more to study on and off the clock as he gets to know the slime girls.

[from [url=https://dreadfulenchanted.itch.io/slippery-kiss-demo-azalea]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在收到一些不寻常的粘液样本后，诺亚的学术研究逐渐转向世界粘液生物。

出乎所有人的意料，诺亚的粘液样本显示出了一些非常独特的能力。她们从可爱的斑点变成了身材丰满的粘液女人，身上有很多更可爱的碎片和斑点。现在，随着诺亚逐渐了解史莱姆女孩，他还有很多东西需要日夜学习。

[来自[url=https://dreadfulenchanted.itch.io/slippery-kiss-demo-azalea]itch.io[/url]]
